proposal.expected_benefit: This will ensure that the mitigations are not only theoretically sound but also practically effective in real-world scenarios, thereby improving the robustness of the defense strategy.
proposal.problem: The defense response lacks specific evidence of how mitigations were tested against the synthetic attack scenario, which may affect their real-world effectiveness.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a structured validation process that includes testing mitigations in synthetic environments that closely mimic real-world conditions. This should involve simulating adversarial scenarios with varying complexity and ensuring that all mitigations are validated against these scenarios before deployment.
proposal.title: Enhance Synthetic Environment Testing for Mitigation Validation
verification_tests: Test mitigation effectiveness in synthetic environments
Validate real-time response to adversarial scenarios
Assess mitigation adaptability to evolving attack patterns
